subject: OrangeApp launch headroom & billing guardrail
messages:
From: Luke Harper <luke@orangeapp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch next week — temporary headroom request + pricing question

Hi Mina,

Quick note from launch ops: we’ve compressed our rollout window for the mobile onboarding flow and expect a short, sharp spike in inference volume starting Monday 9/14 running 36-48 hours. Baseline traffic is fine under the committed tier, but the burst will be roughly ~800k additional requests over that window (rough estimate).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provision a temporary top-up / short-term quota increase for 48 hours? We need guaranteed headroom rather than throttling.
- If there are temporary overrun charges, can you share the expected pricing (blended or per-token overrun rate) and any available one-off credits or a graceband for a first-launch incident?

I attached our launch plan and traffic profile. We’re open to a short MOU for a one-time uplift if it helps with pricing.

Thanks — Luke
Luke Harper
Head of Growth, OrangeApp
orangeapp-launch@orangeapp.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachment: OrangeApp_Launch_Plan.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Luke Harper <luke@orangeapp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch next week — temporary headroom request + pricing question

Hi Luke — thanks for the heads up and for sending the plan, that helps a lot. Quick response with a provisional option so you can finalize cutovers: 

Proposal (48-hour emergency uplift):
- Immediate provision of a temporary 1.0M token headroom pool for 48 hours starting when you flip the traffic switch.
- First 24 hours: graceband on overrun (no charge up to 200k extra tokens).
- After graceband: overrun billed at our short-window uplift rate of $0.000085 / token (blended rate for this uplift).
- If OrangeApp signs a one-month supplemental MOU committing to an additional 1M tokens/month for the next 30 days, we’ll reduce the uplift rate to $0.000068 / token and apply a one-time credit of $1,200 to your invoice.

I’m cc’ing Ben (sales) and Connor (billing) to align on approvals and to create the short MOU if you want to proceed. If this looks good, I can issue the temporary headroom immediately and send the MOU draft for Luke’s signature.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0176
